verdict.rationale: First-party docs clearly describe long unattended runs. After a brief scoping exchange, Marlin works without further human input for up to roughly eight hours of continuous autonomous reasoning, then carries the research through to a delivered report and slides. It also supports cancelling mid-run. Nothing in the evidence shows the user is notified (email, push or otherwise) when the result is ready, so only the unattended-job half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: any documented completion notification mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration of the unattended long-run behavior.
